from pathlib import Path
import json
import time

home = Path.home()
done_task = "CONT-DONE-eba52c84b60e5eb693d28b3d"
continuation_id = "CONT-eba52c84b60e5eb693d28b3d"
task_state = home / ".local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks" / f"{done_task}.json"
cont_state = home / ".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge/continuations" / f"{continuation_id}.json"

deadline = time.time() + 150
last_task = None
last_cont = None
while time.time() < deadline:
    if task_state.is_file():
        try:
            last_task = json.loads(task_state.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            last_task = None
    if cont_state.is_file():
        try:
            last_cont = json.loads(cont_state.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            last_cont = None
    if (
        isinstance(last_task, dict)
        and last_task.get("status") == "DISPATCHED"
        and isinstance(last_cont, dict)
        and last_cont.get("state") == "DONE"
    ):
        break
    time.sleep(2)

print("DONE_TASK_STATE=" + repr(last_task))
print("CONTINUATION_STATE=" + repr(last_cont))

assert isinstance(last_task, dict), "DONE command-bus state missing"
assert last_task.get("task_id") == done_task, last_task
assert last_task.get("status") == "DISPATCHED", last_task
assert last_task.get("parent_continuation_id") == continuation_id, last_task

assert isinstance(last_cont, dict), "continuation state missing"
assert last_cont.get("continuation_id") == continuation_id, last_cont
assert last_cont.get("expected_done_task_id") == done_task, last_cont
assert last_cont.get("state") == "DONE", last_cont

print("A_B_DONE_CANARY=PASS")
print("DONE_RECEIPT_DISPATCHED=PASS")
print("CONTINUATION_TERMINAL_DONE=PASS")
print("HUMAN_CONTINUE_REQUIRED=NO")
